description: What scripts/vendor-controller-assets.py fetches from AL2009man's asset packs, at pinned revisions. prompts: every SVG of these folders of the Gamepad Prompt Asset Pack, except paths containing an excluded word (Guide buttons are platform marks). files: other files to copy as they are. silhouettes: Connection Icon Pack controller types, stored as library/<name>.svg. detailed: Controller Asset Pack drawings stored as library/<name>.svg with these changes: label:<Inkscape layer> or id:<element id> is removed (manufacturer logos and platform marks are trademarks and are not redistributed), show:label:<layer> makes a hidden layer visible; note says why.
